summary: Hallmarking records the proportion of precious metal in an article; a hallmark is an official indication of purity or fineness.
quote: Hallmarking is the accurate determination and official recording of the proportionate content of precious metal in precious metal articles (as per IS 15820).

summary: For hallmarked gold jewellery, check the BIS logo, the caratage and fineness marking, and the six-character alphanumeric HUID.
quote: hallmark consists of 3 marks viz, BIS logo, purity of the article in caratage as well as fineness and six-digit alphanumeric HUID number.
section_heading: 9. What does hallmark on gold jewellery consist of?

summary: On BIS's gold-jewellery guidance, 22K(916) pairs 22-carat gold with fineness 916 parts per thousand. Confirm current permitted grades in the official BIS scheme.

summary: Ask the jeweller for an authentic bill or invoice for the hallmarked article and keep its details for any later dispute or complaint.
quote: Yes,it is necessary to take authentic bills/invoice of the hallmarked article from retailer/jeweller. It is necessary for any dispute/misuse/complaint redressal.
section_heading: 4. Is it necessary to take authentic bills/invoice?

summary: HUID is a unique six-character alphanumeric identifier on a hallmarked item. To check it, use Verify HUID in the official BIS Care app; BIS Bandhu cannot authenticate a code.
quote: HUID is a Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) number and it is one of the components of hallmark. It is a six-digit alphanumeric number which is unique for each hallmarked item and is traceable. Customer can also verify the HUID number in the BIS Care App using the ‘Verify HUID’ feature.

summary: A jeweller seeking BIS registration to sell hallmarked articles can apply online through NSWS. Check the current eligibility and scheme conditions before applying.
quote: articles, willing to obtain Certificate of Registration for Selling Hallmarked Jewellery/artefacts shall apply online at the NSWS portal. The registration is granted instantly.

summary: A registered jeweller can initiate a hallmarking request through the e-BIS portal and select an Assaying and Hallmarking Centre. Confirm the current portal procedure before submission.
quote: At the Jeweller’s end, the jeweller first needs to visit e-BIS website i.e. www.manakonline.in and select the ‘Hallmarking’ tile.

quote: Consumer can get its jewellery/sample tested from any of the BIS Recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centre.
